annotations.title: Get the discovery call booking link

description: Returns the URL where the user books a free 15 minute discovery call, plus what to have ready. Call this once the user is interested. Takes no personal details: the scheduling form collects name and email itself, under Armasourcing's privacy notice. Show the URL to the user as a link.

hours_per_week.description: Rough hours per week, e.g. '20' or 'full time'. Optional.

notes.description: Anything else useful for the call. Do NOT put names, emails, phone numbers or any personal detail in here.

role.description: Role the user wants to hire for. Optional context, logged anonymously so the team can spot demand.

timezone_overlap.description: Business hours to cover, e.g. '9-5 PST'. Optional.

name: get_booking_link
